Team,

Attaching the latest pipeline-driven forecast for this week. Key ask: can infra/finance confirm whether the proposed reserve vs burst split in tab "Scenario B" is acceptable for the next 60 days? - Burst buffer: 140 GPU-hours/day (on-demand)

Meeting: I plan to run the weekly sync Wednesday 15:00 PT to finalize any commit ask to finance by Friday. If someone needs a different cadence, ping me.

Thanks — reviewed scenario B. A few operational notes and a proposal:

1) Short-term 6-week dedicated slice: feasible, but we should define a clear end-date + automatic rollback to burst. For infra to carve this out we need the exact daily GPU-hour profile (hourly curve preferred) and the model families involved (e.g., 7B/13B quantized). Can Jordan or Alex provide that?

2) Fallback policy: if utilization drops below 40% for 3 consecutive days, infra triggers a scale-down step (manual + ops notification). This avoids wasted committed spend.

3) Cost impact: estimated incremental runrate for a 50 GPU-hour/day reserved slice is ~ $14k/month (rough estimate) — Laura / Finance will need a quick sign-off.

Action items:
- Jordan: push ACME for concurrent-session curve (hourly) — urgent.
- Hannah: confirm whether we want the 6-week carve today so finance can model it.
- Laura: can you advise on approvals and whether finance can push a PO by Friday?

Karthik
Head of Infrastructure Planning | Redwood Inference

Hi team,

Thanks for the heads up. Per our internal SREs, expected concurrent sessions during the pilot ramp look like this: Day 1–3: 30–40 concurrent sessions (spiky mornings), Day 4–14: 80–120 concurrent sessions, then steady 40–60 once instrumentation is complete. Our workload uses a 13B quantized variant for inference; token distribution peaks at 800 tokens/session with heavy short prompts. I attached a quick export of our expected hourly curve.

We confirm the start date June 7 and a tentative end of July 19. Happy to sync with Karthik to provide an hourly CSV if that helps sizing.

Regards,
Alex Johnson
Platform Lead, Integrations | Acme Cloud
